Numbers are exact decimal strings, or numerator/denominator where the value does not terminate in decimal.

levelHistogram.note: levelHistogram, added in vectorsVersion 2: a support column's records counted per declared level, ungrouped and grouped by a second support column. One contract, one committed slice, the digests, plan fragment, counts and commitment they produce, then one case per outcome and per fail-closed condition of the kind. Declared levels are listed out of order on purpose: cells are taken sorted. Counts are integers; margins are exact decimal strings.
